title: Scientific Instruments & Laboratory Equipment
painPoint: Scientific instruments such as NMR spectrometers, mass spectrometers, and electron microscopes demand exceptionally stable and uniform magnetic fields. Even minor flux drift, temperature-induced demagnetization, or geometric deviation can corrupt measurement accuracy and reproducibility. Cryogenic and vacuum environments further challenge magnet integrity, while high-coercivity grades are essential to resist stray field interference and vibration. Sourcing magnets with consistent Br, tight dimensional tolerances, and reliable temperature coefficients remains a persistent bottleneck for instrument manufacturers worldwide. Field inhomogeneity beyond ppm levels degrades spectral resolution, making every gauss of deviation a costly compromise.
youjiuSolution: YOUJIU delivers high-precision NdFeB magnets engineered for scientific and laboratory applications, offering grades from N52 for maximum flux density to 35UH and 33EH for cryogenic and high-temperature stability. Our magnets feature NiCuNi and epoxy coatings compatible with vacuum and cleanroom environments, with dimensional tolerances up to plus minus 0.02 mm. Each batch undergoes flux and Hall-sensor field mapping to guarantee batch-to-batch consistency below 1%.
